description: Header file defining the multiplayer connection interface for the Wesnoth game, including classes for managing connected users, game sides, and network interactions.

classes.name: connect
classes.description: Main class managing multiplayer connection UI and network interactions.

classes.name: connect::side
classes.description: Represents a game side/player slot in multiplayer setup.

classes.name: connect::connected_user
classes.description: Data structure for a connected user with name, controller, and network connection.

methods.name: connect::process_event
methods.description: Handles user input and UI events.

methods.name: connect::start_game
methods.description: Initiates game start, resolves factions, and sends start message.

methods.name: connect::layout_children
methods.description: Arranges UI elements within a given rectangle.

methods.name: connect::accept_connections
methods.description: Determines if new network connections are accepted.

methods.name: connect::update_level
methods.description: Updates internal level state based on sides.

methods.name: connect::update_and_send_diff
methods.description: Sends game state differences to clients.

methods.name: connect::sides_available
methods.description: Checks if there are available sides for the game.

methods.name: connect::update_playerlist_state
methods.description: Updates UI elements related to player list and start conditions.

methods.name: connect::find_player_side
methods.description: Finds the side index for a given player ID.

methods.name: connect::kick_player
methods.description: Removes a player from the game.
